I can't say which political party is to blame for high rents. That is a judgment about causation and politics, and the StatCan tools hold statistics, not assessments of party policy or responsibility.

What I can do is pull Statistics Canada data on rents, such as the rent component of the Consumer Price Index, and show how it has changed over time, including by province or city. Those figures describe the trend but don't show what caused it or who is responsible. The search for a rent-specific table was weak, so I'd need one more targeted search before giving exact figures.
